inbox.title: Replace the date picker with the new design system component

detail.author: jlee
detail.body: This PR replaces the old date picker on the booking page and the report filters with the DatePicker from the design system. The old one did not work with the keyboard and had a time zone bug at the end of the month (see #455). I kept the old props as an adapter so the call sites do not change. Screenshots are in the description. I could not test Safari 16, can somebody check it?

inbox.title: Add idempotency keys to the payment endpoints

detail.author: mkowalski
detail.body: I think the key should expire after 24 hours, not 7 days. Stripe uses 24 hours and our retry window is only 6 hours. Also, the middleware stores the full response body; for the export endpoint that can be several MB. Can we store a hash and the status code only, and return 409 when the body differs?

inbox.title: Rotate the database credentials every 30 days

detail.author: spatel
detail.body: @michaelhelvey can the factory take the app side of this? The secret is in the parameter store already; the services read it only at start, so each service must reload it when the rotation event comes. I wrote a list of the services below. The api and the billing-service are the most important ones. The workers can restart; they are stateless. The cron jobs read the secret on each run, so they are fine.

inbox.title: The booking page shows the wrong currency for Swiss customers

detail.author: support-bot
detail.body: Three customers from Switzerland told support that the booking page shows prices in EUR, but the invoice is in CHF. It started after the release on Monday. The locale is de-CH, and the currency map has only de-DE and de-AT.
